title: VESM IN — per-missense scoring request
description: One row per (transcript, protein_position, alt_aa) for which a VESM log-likelihood ratio is requested. VESM = ESM1b-based protein-language-model variant effect score; LLR is the per-residue log-likelihood-ratio of mutant vs reference under the masked LM. KBC consumes the LLR column from variant_master_scored.tsv (Tier 3 cutoff: LLR ≤ −7).

variant_id.description: Canonical variant id from Clair3 OUT — '{chrom}:{pos}:{ref}:{alt}'. Carried through so VESM OUT can be joined back to the variant table.

transcript_id.description: GFF3 transcript_id (canonical transcript for the gene when ambiguous).

protein_id.description: GFF3 protein_id derived from the transcript's CDS.

protein_position.description: 1-based amino-acid position in the reference protein where the substitution occurs.

ref_aa.description: Single-letter reference amino acid. Must match protein_sequence[protein_position-1]. '*' is stop.

alt_aa.description: Single-letter alternate amino acid resulting from this variant. Stop ('*') is in-vocabulary but VESM behaviour at stops is implementation-defined.

protein_sequence.description: Full reference protein sequence in single-letter AA code. Required so VESM can compute the masked-position likelihood without re-deriving from a GFF3.

protein_sequence_source.description: Whether the protein_sequence comes from a straight reference-frame translation of the canonical transcript ('reference_frame', used by MODULE_CONSERVATION) or from a haplotype-resolved translation that incorporates upstream in-cis variants ('haplotype_aware', used by HAPS). KBC's headline uses reference_frame; HAPS produces the haplotype_aware overlay column vesm_llr_haplotype_aware.

model_name.description: ESM model used to compute the LLR. Recorded for reproducibility.

model_revision.description: Optional model weight checksum or release tag, when stricter provenance is needed.
